unit.why: A single narrative: R. Zev Kitzes and R. David Purkes doubt the Besht, are bound by their dead disciple's report from Gan Eden, and are drawn close to him.

stories.summary_en: When the Besht came to Medzhybizh, R. Zev Kitzes and R. David Purkes did not esteem him. Their dying disciple was told by the Besht that he would die and would be brought into Gan Eden. The disciple made a handshake promise to report back, and after death he found no place in Gan Eden because he had not kept that promise. There he saw the Besht teaching Torah, and he reported the question and answer to them in a dream. The answer was confirmed at the third Sabbath meal, and from then on they drew close to the Besht.
